export_evidence: importkey.com/countries/india/india-pistons-ltd — page exists and is titled "INDIA PISTONS LTD- Import Customs Data Records - ImportKey", but the body contains only the paywall text "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world" and "Shipments available for INDIA PISTONS LTD, refreshed daily"; 0 shipment rows visible (0 of an undisclosed counter). No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code was rendered.
domestic_evidence: indiapistons.com (own site) — "India Pistons Limited (IPL) is the oldest and one of the largest producers of Pistons, Piston Rings, Gudgeon Pins & Cylinder Liners and allied components in India." This is a self-description of manufacturing capability, not a supply record; no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report revenue split was retrievable.
note: No shipment-level evidence obtained. Blockers: DuckDuckGo/searx search backend returned "Connection refused" on every attempt (3 tries), so no secondary pages could be located; volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403; importkey free view rendered 0 rows. Therefore export_status = unknown (not none_found) — the absence of visible rows is a paywall artefact, not proof of no shipments. Domestic: the company is a real, long-established Chennai-based piston/piston-ring/liner manufacturer (Sundaram group affiliation, JV with Shaw Development at Hosur announced 21.07.2022 on its own site), so domestic supply is highly plausible, but no GST turnover figure, tender award or contract was seen — status declared_only. HS 840991 (parts for spark-ignition engines) is consistent with the declared product line (pistons, rings, gudgeon pins, liners), so no HS correction is proposed; note the claimed industry "Металлургия и горнодобыча" is a mislabel — actual sector is auto components / precision engineering. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No CIN/PAN verified. Recommend re-run when search backend is restored, targeting Volza/Eximpedia paid views and IPL's MCA filings for turnover.
